اعتقلن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلْنَ (iʕtaqalna) /iʕ.ta.qal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلْنَ (uʕtuqilna) /uʕ.tu.qil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اِعْتَقِلْنَ (iʕtaqilna) /iʕ.ta.qil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
